newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bolivar gains on CenBank dollar sales.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bolivar gains on CenBank dollar sales.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar closed slightly firmer at 473.75/474.75 per dollar Wednesday compared to 474.00/475.00 per dollar Tuesday as the Central Bank sold large quantities of foreign currency to meet heavy demand, traders said.
"The market saw heavy demand (for foreign currency) both at the interbank and final client level but the Central Bank injected a large quantity of currency and covered demand," one trader said.
"If the Central Bank had not intervened as it did the rate would have reached 476 bolivars per dollar," another trader said.
Traders said demand for currency was stronger than in recent weeks and pressure on the bolivar would continue in coming days.
